--- drop_property_graph_if_exists.sql
DROP PROPERTY GRAPH IF EXISTS FinGraph

--- AST
&ast.DropPropertyGraph{
  IfExists: true,
  Name:     &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 30,
        NameEnd: 38,
        Name:    "FinGraph",
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
DROP PROPERTY GRAPH IF EXISTS FinGraph
